name: Poro-Snax
description:
Active - Consume: Serves a scrumptious scoop to a nearby Poro, causing it to grow in size.
This savory blend of Avarosan hen and local Freljordian herbs—picked daily and flash-frozen—contains the essential nutrients necessary to keep your Poro cool and calm.
All proceeds will be donated towards preserving the habitat of the endangered Spotted Poro.
